svg.title: agent-switchboard architecture
svg.desc: Architecture. Your machine: worker sessions (Claude Code in tmux) fire lifecycle events into hooks/board-hook.sh, which writes state files under $BOARD_HOME; bin/board-collect (bash, zero tokens) builds snapshot.json and calls lib/notify.py for Slack, email, LINE, SNS or webhook alerts. The operator session BOARD (an LLM) watches the snapshot and writes it to the Artifact board on claude.ai (write_db) across the trust boundary. A human answers on the board; the operator reads the answer (read_db) and relays it with SendMessage or a guarded bin/board press that sends keys to the worker's tmux pane.
svg.text: Zero-token plumbing on your machine; one LLM operator talks to the cloud board.
